title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E01 — Musician Heal Thyself
The team investigates the death of a petty officer whom Pride had mentored; Brody searches for a place to call home.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E02 — Carrier
When a Navy lieutenant on liberty dies of bubonic plague, NCIS Special Agent Tony DiNozzo helps the New Orleans team as they try to control a potential outbreak and find the source of the infectious disease.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E03 — Breaking Brig
An armored transport bus crashes, resulting in the escape of four prisoners -- including a black market broker topping the list of national security threats; Pride needs Gibbs' help with a case file full of redactions.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E04 — The Recruits
When a Navy SEAL is found dead in a sorority house, the team must determine if his death was related to collegiate foul play or a classified mission; Pride's daughter visits the office.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E05 — It Happened Last Night
The investigation into a chief warrant officer's death reveals that his wife has been abducted -- leaving the team with a 22-hour deadline; senior FBI agent Fornell assists with the case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E06 — Master of Horror
Amidst Halloween festivities in New Orleans, a Naval Staff Judge Advocate dressed in a costume is found dead in a cemetery; the team debates Halloween costumes and activities.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E07 — Watch Over Me
The team investigate the murder of a Navy Officer assigned as a tech liaison with a private developer; Pride turns the carport into an auto shop.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E08 — Love Hurts
A murdered petty officer -- with a proposal and an engagement ring -- is found in a Mardi Gras float storage facility; the members of the team are baffled when they cannot locate the victim's girlfriend.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E09 — Chasing Ghosts
The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — Stolen Valor
A retired SEAL -- who tracked people impersonating military personnel -- is murdered; Brody finds that LaSalle is uncharacteristically unenthusiastic about Christmas.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E11 — Baitfish
The investigation into an explosion at the Navy-Marine Corp Relief Gala reveals Pride was the bomb's target.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E12 — The Abyss
The NCIS team and the Coast Guard Investigative Service work together when a Navy Admiral's daughter is the prime suspect in a double murder on a research boat; LaSalle looks for his estranged brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E13 — The Walking Dead
After learning, he was poisoned with a deadly dose of radiation, a Navy lieutenant commander asks Pride and the team to solve his imminent murder.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E14 — Careful What You Wish For
An agent is killed while working on a security detail for the Vice Chief of Naval Operations; Brody's past is evaluated.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E15 — Le Carnivale de la Mort
A petty officer is murdered during Mardi Gras festivities; Pride contemplates what to tell his daughter about his strained relationship with his father.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E16 — My Brother's Keeper
The NCIS team tries to narrow down the motive when a Navy recruiter is murdered in a hit-and-run; LaSalle worries about his brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E17 — More Now
Pride believes Baitfish has returned and has the NCIS team chase down leads in an attempt to locate him.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E18 — The List
When a sailor is killed in a strip club, the murder weapon turns out to be linked to other unsolved cases; Brody receives a visit from her ex-fiance.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E19 — The Insider
During the autopsy of a petty officer who seems to have died of natural causes, an armed man holds Wade, Sebastian and Danny hostage in the morgue.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E04 — Inherited
The team must determine if the kidnapping of a young Chinese-American woman is a random hate crime or if she was specifically targeted; Jess and Sarah struggle with Tali's continued rebellious streak.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E04 — Callisto
While helping a young woman fight a drug patent lawsuit, the team must travel to the small Texas town where Bull experienced the only trial loss of his career.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E05 — Just Tell the Truth
Bull defends the working class fiancé of a murdered socialite; Marissa, Cable and Danny ask Chunk to let them investigate a new guy he wants to date.

title: Bull
description:
S01 E06 — Bedside Manner
Bull has to find a way to reverse the negative effect of a surgeon with a God complex who is being sued for malpractice; Bull hires a previous client's attorney.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E09 — Ke Koho Mamao Aku
When a cowboy is poisoned, Max must work with a rival medical examiner; McGarrett wants Danny to steal a Christmas tree.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E10 — Wawahi moe'uhane
An old-school private detective helps the Five-0 solve the murder of a young woman who secretly worked as an escort.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E11 — Ua'aihue
When a tourist unknowingly transporting a stolen Van Gogh is murdered, Kono and Chin go undercover into the world of black market art; McGarrett asks chef Masaharu Morimoto to train Kamekona for a shrimp cook-off.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E12 — Poina 'ole
When a neurosurgeon is murdered right before a procedure, the stunning truth about a decades-old disappearance of four school boys is revealed; McGarrett's car is stolen.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E13 — La Po'ino
A patient with a contagious and deadly strain of bird flu is kidnapped -- and the people responsible plan to weaponize the virus.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E14 — Powehiwehi
Kono must fight for her life after discovering a notorious criminal's identity; Adam's ties to his formerly corrupt family business leave Kono feeling concerned.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E15 — E 'Imi Pono
The members of the Five-0 investigate a journalist's past after he is killed; as Valentine's Day draws near, a text mix-up causes Danny to overreact.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E16 — Nanahu
Five-0 and an ATF agent (Melina Kanakaredes) from California team up when a serial arsonist targets couples in Oahu; Amber's abusive ex tracks her down while she is on a romantic getaway with Danny.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E17 — Kuka'awale
Danny and McGarrett work on their relationship as they pursue a woman who escaped after a diamond robbery.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E18 — Pono Kaulike
When Chin and Danny are taken into custody over past deadly transgressions, McGarrett turns to Joe for help.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E19 — Kahania
McGarrett and Odell come under assault at the barbershop while trying to protect a young man being hunted by a gang; Jerry is accused of a series of home invasions.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E20 — Ike Hanau
The wife of one of Grover's closest friends falls to her death; Dr. Shaw and Danny are stuck in an elevator with a body that needs processing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E21 — Ua helele'i ka hoku
After a murder takes place at a convention of Elvis impersonators, the victim's body is stolen; Gabriel asks Chin for help.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E22 — Ho'amoano
When a dead woman is found in a hotel suite belonging to three married, hungover men, the team must help them retrace their steps as they try to remember what happened -- and find the killer.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E23 — Mo'o 'olelo Pu
During a solo outrigger trip, Kono encounters bad weather and must fight for her life; the Five-0 investigates a man in trouble for cooking meth.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E24 — Luapo'i
After apprehending a fugitive, a bounty hunter is murdered; Rachel reveals a secret to Danny that has ramifications; Chin talks to McGarrett about his concerns regarding Adam.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S05 E25 — A Make Kaua
On the eve of Adam and Kono's wedding, the Five-0 must stop a fanatical patriot who wants to detonate stolen nuclear warheads and place the blame on a terrorist -- resulting in a new war on terror.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E01 — Mai ho`oni i ka wai lana mâlie
The team investigates a centuries-old pirate story involving buried treasure; Gabriel kidnaps Kono and Adam on the morning after their wedding.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E02 — Lehu a Lehu
A bomb squad is attacked, and the culprit threatens to detonate hidden explosive devices unless arsonist Jason Sinclair (Randy Couture) is released from prison.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S06 E03 — Ua 'o'oloku ke anu i na mauna
A scuba diver is killed with a gun that was used in a recent murder; McGarrett gets ready to propose to Catherine.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E05 — Unhinged
After a deadly fire at an arcade, the team discovers the blaze was just the first step in an intricate plan to exact revenge on one of the victims; Hana rejoins the team, finding new adjustments in all aspects of her life.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E04 — Guts + Fuel + Hope
MacGyver and Riley must find a way to drive a tanker filled with liquid oxygen through a region occupied by rebels and deliver it to a children's hospital; Riley helps MacGyver decide whether to allow his father back into his life.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E05 — Dia de Muertos + Sicarios + Family
Mac and Jack rush to Mexico to help capture the leader of a drug cartel while the country celebrates Día de Muertos.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E06 — Murdoc + MacGyver + Murdoc
Murdoc abducts MacGyver's girlfriend to force Mac to help him rescue his son from a kidnapper; a dangerous person from Murdoc's personal life shows up, giving Mac a glimpse into the villain's past.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E07 — Scavengers + Hard Drive + Dragonfly
Matty sends the team to Ghana to recover a hard drive from an e-waste landfill that is run by a powerful and violent man, leading them to speculate about what could be on the device.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E08 — Revenge + Catacombs + Le Fantome
An Irish military intelligence officer claims to know the whereabouts of a lethal bomb maker whom Mac has been hunting for years.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E09 — Specimen 234 + PAPR + Outbreak
When a vial containing a deadly virus is stolen from the Center for Disease Control in Atlanta, MacGyver and team race to recover it before the thief unleashes a global pandemic.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E10 — Matty + Ethan + Fidelity
Matty reveals the shocking secret that her husband has been undercover in a criminal organization for eight years; when his status as a CIA agent comes out, Matty needs MacGyver to find and extract her husband before it's too late.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E17 — In the Dark
The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating simultaneously when victims killed in two different ways are discovered in the same city; the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E18 — Hell's Kitchen
The BAU investigates an urban vampire who kidnaps his victims at night and holds them underground in the sewer system; Reid makes a difficult decision in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E19 — True North
The BAU is called to investigate after three victims are discovered tied to stakes in the brutal Arizona desert.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E20 — Unforgettable
The BAU investigates when several federal government employees, including a close friend of Walker's, succumb to symptoms of a heart attack; Reid anxiously awaits his trial date.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E21 — Green Light
When Reid fears his mother has been abducted, he asks the BAU to investigate while he's stuck in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E22 — Red Light
Morgan brings the BAU new information in the case against Mr. Scratch, a serial killer and escaped convict who has been wreaking havoc on the team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E01 — Wheels Up
Agent Matt Simmons joins the BAU team in a race to take down Mr. Scratch and save one of their own in the process.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E02 — To a Better Place
The BAU investigates three similar crimes in which victims' remains are discovered in old suitcases.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E03 — Blue Angel
When an anger-driven, unknown subject targets successful businessmen in Detroit, the BAU must investigate.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E04 — Killer App
The BAU investigates a workplace shooting committed by a state-of-the-art drone in Silicon Valley.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E05 — Lucky Strikes
Morgan returns to the BAU to help Penelope deal with a case that has affected her emotionally.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E06 — The Bunker
The BAU must find out what several missing women have in common to find them.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E07 — Dust and Bones
The BAU searches for a subject who is targeting prominent members of the community.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E08 — Neon Terror
The BAU is called in to investigate when a criminal sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E09 — False Flag
The BAU is called to investigate when two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, N.M., perish in quick succession.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E10 — Submerged
When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team searches for an UnSub who has a puzzling past.

title: FBI: Most Wanted
description:
S03 E06 — Lovesick
The team attempts to hunt down a family annihilator before he continues his murder spree; Barnes' intrusive mother puts pressure on her marriage.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E07 — Poisoned Minds
Toby and Michelle investigate the death of a pharmaceutical executive who released a drug with killer results.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E08 — Now You See Him
Toby and Michelle must recapture an escaped criminal mastermind before he can seek revenge.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E09 — Crossed
Toby starts doubting his abilities after Michelle questions his insights during their investigation into a wealthy philanthropist's murder.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E03 — Excessive Force
When the team consults for the NYPD on the defense of a police officer accused of excessive force in the shooting of an unarmed man, the social politics surrounding the case create tension within their own ranks.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E04 — Justice for Cable
Business becomes personal for Bull when TAC assists with a civil suit against the bank that funded the terrorists responsible for Cable's death; Marissa enlists her former homeland security co-worker Taylor Rentzel to help with the suit.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E05 — The Missing Piece
Bull joins the defense team of a seemingly unwinnable case when a doctor is put on trial after his DNA links him to a homicide; Bull and Benny work on selecting jurors who are predisposed to trust their instincts instead of incontrovertible evidence.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E06 — Fool Me Twice
Bull and the TAC team must help when Marissa's restaurateur husband is charged with involuntary manslaughter after one of his employees dies, allegedly because of negligence; Bull and Benny aim to select jurors who will believe it was an accident.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E07 — A Girl Without Feelings
Bull confronts his guilt over closing his psychiatric practice when a former patient goes on trial for killing her brother; Bull and Benny enter an insanity defense plea and aim to seat jurors that are sympathetic to mental illness.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E08 — But for the Grace
Bull takes on a pro bono client who was poorly advised by his public defender to plead guilty to a misdemeanor assault charge and is now facing felony manslaughter after the victim dies.

title: Bull
description:
S03 E09 — Separation
Danny looks to her colleagues for help when her boyfriend is arrested and threatened with deportation; Bull represents a German national who is being sued by a museum over possession of a valuable painting.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E10 — The Man in the Mud
When the remains of a professional motorcycle racer are found in a hot spring, the team suspects his rival to be the murderer; Dr. Lance Sweets forces Booth and Brennan to accompany him on a double date.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E11 — Player Under Pressure
Brennan and Booth investigate the college-basketball world to determine who is responsible for the murder of a player on a nationally ranked team.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E12 — The Baby in the Bough
After a woman's car is run off the road, only her baby survives; Booth and Brennan go to the woman's hometown to investigate.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E13 — The Verdict in the Story
When Max (Ryan O'Neal) goes on trial for the murder of FBI Deputy Director Robert Kirby, all the team members but Brennan are called as expert witnesses for the prosecution.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E14 — The Wannabe in the Weeds
An aspiring singer (Ace Young) is murdered and, as Brennan and Booth investigate the musician's fans and foes, one obsessed woman transfers her affections to Booth.

title: Bones
description:
S03 E15 — The Pain in the Heart
A human jawbone found at the Jeffersonian alerts Brennan and the team that the Gormogon serial killer has struck again; a lab explosion lands Zack in the hospital; Gormogon's silver skeleton disappears from the vault.

title: Bones
description:
S04 E01 — Yanks in the U.K.
When Brennan and Booth go to London to guest-lecture at Oxford and Scotland Yard, local officials ask them to help investigate the murder of a young heiress; Angela's long-estranged husband returns.
